summary_en: BCPE Blitz Cayman raised its tender offer price for Kakaku.com from 3,597 yen to 3,700 yen per share, or 3,720 yen if a non-subscription agreement with KDDI is executed. All necessary regulatory clearances have been obtained, and the tender offer will commence upon receipt of the target company's board endorsement.
title_en: Notice of Partial Change Regarding Notice of Scheduled Commencement of Tender Offer for Kakaku.com Inc. (TSE Prime: 2371) by BCPE Blitz Cayman, L.P. (Progress Disclosure)
translation_en_brief:
BCPE Blitz Cayman, L.P., a limited partnership advised by Bain Capital Private Equity and in which LINE Yahoo will indirectly invest, announced on October 26, 2026, that it is raising the tender offer price for Kakaku.com Inc. (TSE Prime: 2371) from 3,597 yen per share to 3,700 yen per share. If a non-subscription agreement is executed with KDDI Corporation—whereby KDDI agrees not to tender its 35,016,000 shares (17.55% of outstanding shares) and commits to support subsequent delisting procedures including a share consolidation—the price would be 3,720 yen per share.

As of the announcement date, all regulatory clearances necessary to proceed with the tender offer have been obtained. The bidder states that it will commence the tender offer promptly once Kakaku.com's board of directors passes a resolution expressing support for the offer and recommending that shareholders tender their shares. This follows an affirmative recommendation from Kakaku.com's special committee established to review the going-private transaction.
